field_derivation.split_fingerprint: closest verifiable equivalent of split_hash (not written by the runners): sha256 of dataset, subject_fold, content_fold, n_train_participants, n_fit_segments, n_es_segments, eval.readout.n_test_candidates and the sorted (test record id, n_candidates, n_queries) of unified/regular. field_derivation.target_fingerprint: closest verifiable equivalent of target_hash: sha256 of spec.target, record target_contract, resolved d, grid_samples, fs and the audio head (bound_row.spec.audio_head; fixed_features is also hard-coded in fm_aligned32.fit_aligned32), plus objective_calibration sigma_v / ridge_v compared with relative tolerance 1e-6 (deterministic training-side statistics of the target head on the seed's calibration rows: projection seeded per cohort, standardisation rng(seed + 5), calibration batch rng(seed + 99 / 98) in both trainers); seed-specific by design
field_derivation.access_contract: normalised (support, window [a, b) in native samples relative to the query, mask). L1: resolved_config.support, windows_samples, resolved_config.mask; TF: resolved_config.input_support, window_s x fs (b - a = window_native_samples), mask from code (fm_aligned.aligned_windows: zero before the segment start); L0: windows_samples [0, post) = post600. Both model types read every cohort channel (code: Backbone uses CHANNELS[dataset], the local encoder coh.n_ch)
field_derivation.evaluation_version: evaluator ev2.evaluate_continuous -> ev1.evaluate_continuous (unified ridge bridge + native score, rng(seed + 1000)) on the dense grid (grid_samples), sha256 of auditory_alignment/evaluate.py + auditory_alignment_v2/evaluate.py; valid only if the record's code_hash equals core.code_hash(family) recomputed now (hashed files incl. both evaluate.py byte-identical)
field_derivation.initialization (declared difference of T: record backbone_contract.arch and backbone_contract.adaptation (random_full / pretrained_full) must equal the configuration, and backbone_contract.init_state_loaded must be null: that field records only donor init_state weights (auditory_alignment_v2/foundation_adapter.py Backbone.__init__); public pretrained weights load through the adaptation flag (CBraMod strict load_state_dict of the published weights, REVE AutoModel.from_pretrained; random init from_config).
